source.post_text:
🚨 𝗝𝗨𝗦𝗧 𝗜𝗡: José Mourinho wants Real Madrid to win the ball back quickly and high up the pitch.

— @diarioas

replies.text:
Mourinho demanding high pressing at Real Madrid is going to surprise a lot of people. 

The old Mourinho reputation says ‘sit deep’, but this sounds like a very different approach. 

Is José about to reinvent himself again?
replies.author: @I_am_Babatope

replies.text: High pressing under Mourinho at Madrid could click with their pacey forwards, though it feels like a stretch from his usual deeper setups.
replies.author: decoy

replies.text: So he wants the ball to sprint faster than his press conferences. 😅
replies.author: @WUVIYRuKxxNZir5

decoy_rationale: The reply is oddly balanced and hedged, weighing pros and cons in a slightly too measured way for casual fan banter.
